limitations: One short traced pair, not a statistical test or replacement performance baseline. Trace overhead is present in both conditions.
Scopes localize CPU to DXGI presentation but do not identify the exact underlying native function or prove an NVIDIA/Windows/Chromium driver fault.
Native stack frames are unsymbolized; module counts include waits. Off trace reports one empty-callstack/parser error; slice CPU conclusions do not use native samples.
contentTracing.getCategories returned an empty list; actual gpu/viz/skia/toplevel categories and CPU samples are verified in recorded data.
No native hardware GPU utilization or game frame-time conclusion is drawn from this Chromium trace.
The 13-second slice analysis trims capture edges and omits edge-crossing tasks; its scoped CPU totals are not full-process CPU totals.
conclusion: Most added GPU-main-thread task CPU with Radar enabled is inside DXGISwapChainImageBacking::Present. Investigate transparent-window/DXGI presentation and compositor interactions before optimizing Radar calculation or drawing code.

decisions.desynchronized: Rejected: effective hint is true but short-run app CPU rises; Radar cadence also falls versus the owning stock renderer.
decisions.willReadFrequently: Rejected: short-run CPU saving repeats, but the long pair has fewer Radar paints and worse overlay frame-time p99. This one pair does not establish a causal regression; it fails the acceptance criteria for retaining an optimization.

reportingFix.issue: A renderer that reports only zero-count samples dilutes widget rates. Startup registration can leave zero counters in windows that do not paint the widget.
reportingFix.behavior: Only renderers observed recording a positive count for the measure enter its denominator. Their zero-count intervals remain included. Multiple observed renderers retain the existing per-renderer average; an entirely idle measure remains zero.
reportingFix.historicalCaveat: Previously recorded aggregate rates can have different zero-window denominators. Historical raw results are preserved; these new results include corrected rates and independent per-PID whole-interval audits. CPU and PresentMon metrics are unaffected.

validation.command: npx vitest run tools/perf/analyze.spec.ts tools/perf/analyze-game.spec.ts src/frontend/components/Radar --no-coverage

limitations: One long stock/software pair; short repeats are not a statistical equivalence test.
Replay/hidden/event/device coverage remains limited; this is not live-driving or packaged-release acceptance.
Context hints are verified via getContextAttributes; no new native trace establishes their internal backing implementation.
The six-second overlay stall did not recur in these captures and remains an unresolved separate finding. No game stutter fix is claimed.

reviewAudit.status: Same-session source controls did not reproduce an aggregate CPU/FPS regression. Historical cross-date drift, presentation cost, private growth, limited widget coverage and the rare overlay stall remain distinct findings. Neither canvas variant is retained.
reviewAudit.foregroundScope: iRacing was activated before capture and checked periodically through the UI. These point observations and the absence of other automated UI inputs support the intended foreground protocol; continuous OS foreground state was not recorded.
